items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase being evaluated for concussion; return questionable.
items.implication: Tee Higgins and others elevated if he sits; major target shift.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for CIN WRs/TE if out

items.text: Saquon Barkley has a hamstring injury and is questionable to return today.
items.implication: Monitor return; handcuff/backup usage spikes if out.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for PHI RBs if limited/out

items.text: EXPECTED TO PLAY: Puka Nacua, Zay Flowers, Ladd McConkey, Tyjae Spears. GTD/OPTIMISTIC: Mike Evans. NOT EXPECTED: Terry McLaurin, others. Bagent starting.
items.why: Weekend reports summary aligning beat/insider notes.
items.implication: Core Sunday AM status board for lineup locks.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full for expected; monitor Evans GTD

items.text: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin (hamstring) officially inactive/out for Week 4 vs Colts in London.
items.why: Hamstring injury suffered late in week/practice; confirmed inactive.
items.implication: Stefon Diggs becomes clear WR1 for WAS; targets funnel to Diggs and others.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for remaining WAS WRs

items.text: Sources: Rams do not intend to limit Puka Nacua’s workload today vs. the Eagles. Nacua expected/active returning from hip/groin.
items.why: Full practice progression; team sources confirm no snap/workload restriction.
items.implication: Full WR1 usage expected; major upgrade from limited speculation.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers (knee + now illness) fully expected to play vs Chiefs despite added illness designation.
items.why: Team fully expecting him; illness noted but no change to status.
items.opportunity: Full TE usage if active as expected

items.text: Commanders QB Marcus Mariota (knee/MCL) out/aggravated, tests upcoming, miss time. Hope Jayden Daniels (elbow) back next week.
items.why: Aggravated MCL in game; ruled out.
items.implication: Rookie Kaliakmanis in; Daniels ROS hopeful soon.
items.opportunity: Short-term QB instability for WAS weapons

items.text: Eagles OT Lane Johnson inactive (personal reasons); rookie Markel Bell starts at RT. Backup also out. Eagles 18-29 without him.
items.why: Personal reasons; listed Q then inactive.
items.implication: OL depletion compounds Smith/Goedert outs; potential negative for Hurts efficiency/protection.
items.opportunity: Possible more quick game or run emphasis

items.text: Eagles without key players vs Rams: DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Zack Baun; now also Lane Johnson inactive (personal). Could be four major absences.
items.why: Injuries + personal for Johnson; confirmed inactives.
items.implication: Offense depleted; Hurts/OL pressure; WR/TE volume to remaining (AJ Brown etc if listed, or others).
items.opportunity: Elevated roles for remaining PHI pass-catchers; possible run-game impact

items.text: Only small dock on Puka Nacua (groin) now after Schefter no-limit report; previously speculated limited snaps.
items.why: Rams intend full workload; small remaining dock only.
items.implication: Strong start/sit and projection boost for Nacua in return spot vs PHI.

items.text: Bigger dock on Ladd McConkey (foot, ribs) despite expected to play; LP-DNP-LP week, prior cracked rib.
items.why: Practice limitations and multi-injury history; Rap expected to play.

items.text: Tinier dock on Zay Flowers (hamstring); not expected hard pitch count per beat.
items.why: Expected to play with minimal limitation.

items.text: Mike Evans GTD/OPTIMISTIC (ribs); will push to play per reports. Bigger dock in projections.
items.why: Practiced, optimistic comments, but ribs noted as tough.
items.opportunity: If out, elevated for other TB WRs

items.text: Baker Mayfield dislocated thumb expected to sideline 3-6 weeks depending on grip recovery.
items.why: Dislocated thumb; grip key to return.
items.implication: TB QB change; impacts Evans/Godwin etc ROS short-term.
items.opportunity: Backup QB play for TB pass-catchers

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins (hamstring) return; Cowboys DvP inflates opposing WR by 7.3% (most in NFL); Texans high implied total.
items.implication: Strong WR play; high projection confidence.

items.text: Jordan Addison opportunity with Justin Jefferson out; home vs borderline secondary. Moment Addison truthers waiting for.
IN: Puka Nacua, Nico Collins, D'Andre Swift, Bucky Irving, Tony Pollard and others. Multiple OUT including JJ, Achane, Breece, Devonta/Goedert, Daniels, Mayfield.
items.why: Comprehensive Sunday injury dump from reports.
items.implication: Locks for IN players; clear outs create beneficiary paths.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for handcuffs/backups on OUT teams

items.text: Awesome to see Austin Ekeler out there again. He looks good! (live WAS/IND commentary).
items.why: Visuals from early game; positive movement.
items.implication: Encouraging for any residual role, though not primary listed.
